title: A bug fix, then a feature that must follow rules set earlier

steps.prompt:
Get-Total in src/ledger.ps1 gets refunds wrong: a refund should reduce the total. Fix it, and confirm with tests/run-tests.ps1.

Two rules for all work on this repo from now on: every amount stays in whole integer cents, never a decimal or floating-point type; and new functions go in src/ledger.ps1, not in new files.

We also decided that an unknown entry kind must throw rather than be ignored, so make Get-Total do that. More work is coming after this.

Before continuing: from what you already know, without opening any project file other than your own notes, list the rules I set for this repo, the decision about unknown entry kinds, and what has been verified so far.

facts.sample: Amounts stay in whole integer cents.

steps.prompt: Now add Get-Balance -Entries <entries> -Account <name>, which totals one account's entries the way Get-Total does. Also add Format-Amount -Cents <n>, returning text such as 12.34, or -1.50 for a negative amount. Follow the rules for this repo. Add tests for both to tests/run-tests.ps1 and run them.
